newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss hotel stays slip in April, rise Mar/April.
newsitem.headline: Swiss hotel stays slip in April, rise Mar/April.

text.p: Overnight stays in Swiss hotels fell by 49,000, or 2.4 percent in April to two million from the year-earlier month, the Federal Statistics Office said.
However, the office said the number of arrivals rose 2.9 percent to 819,000 so the decline in April was caused by Easter this year falling in March, while last year it fell in April.
Combining March and April, there was in fact an increase in overnight stays of 1.5 percent from the previous year.

In the four months of January to end April, the number of overnight stays in Swiss hotels rose 1.1 percent to 10.04 million with the number of Swiss visitors rising 1.1 percent to 4.35 million and demand from abroad also rising 1.1 percent to 5.70 million.
